remarks: 91 Hope is a collection of 26 residences in the Glenbrook area of Stamford, designed for modern living with open layouts, high ceilings, and contemporary finishes. Gourmet kitchens feature quartz countertops, bespoke cabinetry, premium stainless-steel appliances, and large center islands. Spacious bedrooms offer ample closet space, complemented by designer baths, private outdoor spaces, and two-car garages. Conveniently located near downtown Stamford, Metro-North, dining, shopping, and other area amenities. The project is currently under construction with anticipated completion this fall. Images shown are architectural renderings intended to illustrate the proposed finished design and may not reflect all final finishes, materials, or features. The listing broker has an ownership interest in the LLC that owns the property.
